title: Artemis landings may contaminate Moon’s ancient ice, study finds
description: A new study suggests rocket exhaust from future lunar missions could contaminate pristine ice deposits near the Moon's poles, potentially destroying valuable chemical evidence that may reveal how life began on Earth.

title: New Space Exploration Gallery At Bhopal Blends Ancient Indian Concepts With Space Technology — VIDEO
description: CM Mohan Yadav inaugurated the Space Exploration Gallery at the Regional Science Centre in Bhopal, featuring over 30 interactive exhibits. Developed with NCSM and the district administration, the gallery blends ancient Indian concepts with modern space technology. It showcases India’s space journey, including Aryabhata, Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, Aditya-L1 and the upcoming Gaganyaan mission.
